title: Representative ChainSquare in the named diagram
statement: On a pair of good constructible representatives in the fixed diagram, scalar extension of the Roos tensor reindexing representative map followed by the scalar tensor representative map and the tensor of the termwise coefficient transition equals S.derived at the tensor representative followed by the scalar-then-reindex tensor representative map. This is the representative chain square, prior to normalization by completed-tensor comparison isomorphisms and faithful descent.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; Apply the mixed chain equality before localization. The generic exact-derived chain-square lemma moves the localization factors by naturality and gives the representative equation.

proof.text: At every quotient and homogeneous tensor summand, use the pure-tensor clause for S and generator clauses for T,T′. Balancing identifies the two scalar/reindexing routes. Their Koszul signs and quotient transitions agree. The two product-coordinate equations of the Roos comparisons then give the chain square before localization.

Apply podCoefficientExactSquareChain to move localization factors through the maps. Its exact-derived comparison formula identifies S.derived. The named tensor representative functor maps the termwise transition by the Q-image of its chain tensor map; unfold these explicit maps to obtain the equation.

theorem podTensorMixedRepresentativeChainSquareDiagram
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (_hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (_hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
    (D' : PodCompletionReindex l L g) (_hD' : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l L g D')
    (T' : PodCompletedTensorReindex l L g D')
    (_hT' : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l L g D' T')
    (S : PodReindexCoefficientTransition l E L ι g D D')
    (_hcore : PodReindexCoefficientTransition.Core l E g L ι D D' S) :
  ∀ P, (podTensorDiagramScalarFunctor l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S _hcore).map
    ((podTensorDiagramReindexChain l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S _hcore) P) ≫
      (podTensorDiagramScalarChain l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S _hcore)
        (((podTensorDiagramGoodReindex l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S _hcore).prod
          (podTensorDiagramGoodReindex l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S _hcore)).obj P) ≫
      (podTensorDiagramTargetRepresentative l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S _hcore).map
        ((NatIso.prod (podTensorDiagramGoodTransition l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S
        _hcore)
          (podTensorDiagramGoodTransition l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S
        _hcore)).hom.app P)
            = (podTensorDiagramDerivedTransition l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T' _hT' S
              _hcore).hom.app ((podTensorDiagramSourceRepresentative l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D'
        _hD' T'
                _hT' S _hcore).obj P) ≫ (podTensorDiagramMixedChain l E g D _hD T _hT L ι D' _hD' T'
                  _hT' S _hcore) P
